# 什么是 Google AI Mode？

- 原标题：What Is Google AI Mode?
- 作者：Flavio Amiel Roborank 创始人
- 原文更新日期：2026-07-14
- 原文：https://roborank.io/glossary/google-ai-mode/
- 栏目：[AI Search & GEO](https://roborank.io/ai-search/)
- 说明：中文全文翻译，后附英文原文。原文中的数据、观点、平台说明及推广内容均按原文保留，未经独立验证。

---

## 中文全文

Google AI Mode 是 Google 搜索中的一种独立对话式搜索体验，它基于实时网页结果开展完整的生成式对话。它利用查询扇出技术在后台发起多次搜索，综合生成一个附带引用的答案，并支持后续追问。它不同于 AI 概览，后者是嵌在常规搜索结果列表上方的摘要。

### 关键要点

- Google 于 2025 年 3 月 5 日推出 AI Mode，最初是面向美国 Google One AI Premium 订阅用户、需要主动加入的 Search Labs 实验，运行于定制版本的 Gemini 2.0。
- 在 2025 年 5 月 20 日的 Google I/O 大会上，AI Mode 向所有美国用户开放，无需报名 Search Labs，并升级为定制 Gemini 2.5 模型。
- AI Mode 是独立标签页和完整聊天界面；AI 概览则是出现在普通蓝色链接结果上方的内嵌摘要块。它们是两个不同的展示入口，并非同一功能。
- AI Mode 的核心机制是查询扇出：先将问题拆分为子主题，针对多个数据源并发执行大量搜索，再写出一个答案。

### Google AI Mode 如何运作

AI Mode 以独立标签页的形式出现在标准搜索结果旁边。用户打开它并提问时，Google 并不只是回答输入的那串文字。它会执行[查询扇出](https://roborank.io/glossary/query-fan-out/)：将问题拆成多个子主题，再同时针对这些子主题和多个数据源发起大量相关搜索。模型会对取回的所有信息进行综合推理，写出一个附带网页链接的答案。因为用户处于聊天界面，他们可以继续追问、深入探索，而不必每次都从头发起一次新搜索。

这一扇出步骤，正是行为差异的关键。普通搜索，以及它上方的 [AI 概览](https://roborank.io/glossary/ai-overviews/)，以用户输入的词语为中心。AI Mode 则会主动扩展到这些词语之外。例如，有人要求 AI Mode 针对某个具体用途比较两个方案时，它可能分别针对每个方案、使用场景、价格、可靠性和替代选项发起后台搜索，再将结果整合起来。它引用的页面，是最能回答这些隐藏子查询的页面，不一定是会因原始问题措辞而获得排名的页面。

与 AI 概览一样，AI Mode 以 Google 的实时搜索索引为[依据](https://roborank.io/glossary/grounding/)，而不是只依赖模型固定的训练数据。因此，及时更新、可抓取且值得信任的页面依然重要。变化的是选取来源的方式。针对 AI Mode 的优化，与其说是赢得某一个查询，不如说是在一组相关子主题上成为最清晰的来源。这也是[生成式引擎优化](https://roborank.io/glossary/generative-engine-optimization/)和[答案引擎优化](https://roborank.io/glossary/answer-engine-optimization/)的核心逻辑。

### Google AI Mode 示例

最清晰、有据可查的例子，就是 Google 自己的发布过程。2025 年 3 月 5 日，Google 将 AI Mode 作为需要主动加入的 Search Labs 实验推出，首先提供给美国的 Google One AI Premium 订阅用户。在[发布文章](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/search/ai-mode-search/)中，Google 将其描述为“一项新的生成式 AI 实验”，用于“需要进一步探索、比较和推理的问题”，并表示它运行于“定制版本的 Gemini 2.0”。同一篇文章还直接说明了其机制：AI Mode“使用查询扇出技术，跨多个子主题和数据源并行发起多次相关搜索，再将所有结果汇总起来”。

Google 明确将它与 AI 概览区分开来。AI 概览当时已经是标准的内嵌功能，也就是普通搜索结果上方的摘要块。AI Mode 则是面向重度用户、需要主动加入的更深入体验，通过独立标签页进入。两者在同一天以不同的界面入口共存。

大约十周后，在 2025 年 5 月 20 日的 Google I/O 大会上，Google 取消了主动报名这道门槛。[I/O 更新公告](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/search/google-search-ai-mode-update/)宣布，AI Mode 正向所有美国用户推出，“无需报名 Labs”，并改用定制版本的 Gemini 2.5。该更新还介绍了 AI Mode 内的 Deep Search，将扇出进一步扩展：它“能够发起数百次搜索，对分散的信息进行推理，并在几分钟内生成专家级、引用完整的报告”。Google 还将 AI Mode 定位为试验场，表示随着反馈积累，会“将 AI Mode 中的许多功能和能力逐步引入核心搜索体验”。

两次公告体现出一致的方向：AI Mode 是 Google 测试其最深入的 AI 搜索行为的地方，包括大量扇出、多步推理和持续对话；AI 概览则继续作为大多数搜索用户默认看到的、更轻量的内嵌层。

### 人们容易弄错的一点

我最常见到的错误，是把 AI Mode 和 AI 概览视为同一个东西的两种衡量方式。它们是两个独立的展示入口，进入方式、模型和行为都不同。AI 概览是 Google 在用户输入一次查询后，插入普通结果上方的内容块；AI Mode 则是用户主动进入的地方，一个问题会触发几十次后台搜索，用户还会继续对话。一个页面可能在 AI 概览中被大量引用，却几乎从不出现在 AI Mode 里，因为扇出会围绕原始查询没有明确提到的子主题收集候选来源。如果报告把两者压成一个“AI 流量”数字，你就无法知道究竟是哪个入口在引用你，也无法知道自己在哪个入口正在失去优势。

### Google AI Mode 与 AI 概览的对比

|  | Google AI Mode | AI 概览 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **界面** | 用户打开的独立标签页和完整聊天界面 | 普通结果列表上方的内嵌摘要块 |
| **进入方式** | 用户主动切换进入 | 在符合条件的查询中自动出现 |
| **交互** | 对话式，支持后续追问 | 单次回答，对应用户输入的那一个查询 |
| **查询处理** | 跨许多子主题执行大量[查询扇出](https://roborank.io/glossary/query-fan-out/) | 以原始查询为中心的较轻量检索 |
| **推出时间** | 2025 年 3 月 5 日进入 Search Labs；2025 年 5 月 20 日面向全部美国用户开放 | 更早作为标准搜索功能推出 |
| **报告方式** | 作为独立的 [AI 可见度](https://roborank.io/glossary/ai-visibility/)入口追踪 | 单独追踪；被引用的页面并不相同 |

两者都以 Google 搜索索引为[依据](https://roborank.io/glossary/grounding/)，也都会引用网页，因此其底层 SEO 基础有重合。但它们选择来源的方式不同，一个页面在其中一个入口的[引用份额](https://roborank.io/glossary/citation-share/)，几乎不能说明它在另一个入口的表现。混在一起衡量时，它们会掩盖彼此；分开衡量时，每个入口都能显示你真正在哪些地方获胜，以及哪些地方的[零点击](https://roborank.io/glossary/zero-click-search/)答案正在悄悄满足用户，却没有带来访问。

### 常见问题

#### 什么是 Google AI Mode？

Google AI Mode 是 Google 搜索内的对话式搜索体验，通过独立标签页打开，基于实时网页结果进行生成式对话。它用查询扇出同时搜索多个子主题，返回一个附带引用的综合答案，并允许用户继续追问。

#### Google AI Mode 和 AI 概览是一回事吗？

不是。AI 概览是 Google 在普通搜索结果上方显示的内嵌摘要。AI Mode 是你主动打开的独立标签页和完整聊天界面。两者采用不同配置，行为也不同，尽管它们都引用网页，并都依赖 Google 的搜索索引。

#### Google 什么时候推出了 AI Mode？

Google 于 2025 年 3 月 5 日推出 AI Mode，最初是面向美国 Google One AI Premium 订阅用户、需要主动加入的 Search Labs 实验。在 2025 年 5 月 20 日的 Google I/O 大会上，它开始向全部美国用户开放，无需注册加入，之后在 2025 年进一步扩展到更多国家。

#### AI Mode 中的查询扇出如何运作？

查询扇出会将问题拆分为多个子主题，并针对多个数据源同时发起大量搜索。AI Mode 随后对这些结果进行推理，写出一个综合答案。因此，它可以引用与某些子主题相关的页面，而这些子主题在你的原始措辞中可能根本没有出现。

### 核心结论

Google AI Mode 不是放大版的 AI 概览，而是一个让搜索变成对话的独立入口。一个问题会扇出成多次后台搜索，模型对所有结果进行推理，用户则留下来继续追问。对于追踪 AI 可见度的人来说，实用结论是：把 AI Mode 当成独立入口衡量，因为它所引用的页面，是通过子主题扇出选出来的，而不只是依据用户输入的那一个查询。

## 英文原文

Google AI Mode is a dedicated conversational search experience inside Google Search that runs a full generative chat over live web results. It uses a query fan-out technique to issue many background searches, synthesizes a single cited answer, and supports follow-up questions — distinct from AI Overviews, which are inline summaries above the standard results list.

### Key Takeaways

- Google launched AI Mode on March 5, 2025 as an opt-in Search Labs experiment for Google One AI Premium subscribers in the US, running on a custom version of Gemini 2.0.
- At Google I/O on May 20, 2025, AI Mode opened to all US users with no Labs sign-up required and was upgraded to a custom Gemini 2.5 model.
- AI Mode is a separate tab and full chat interface; AI Overviews is an inline summary block that appears above ordinary blue-link results — they are two different surfaces, not one feature.
- AI Mode’s defining mechanic is query fan-out: it breaks a question into subtopics and issues many searches concurrently across multiple data sources before writing one answer.

### How Google AI Mode Works

AI Mode sits beside the standard search results as its own tab. When a user opens it and asks a question, Google does not simply answer the string that was typed. It runs a [query fan-out](https://roborank.io/glossary/query-fan-out/): the question is broken into subtopics, and Google issues a multitude of related searches simultaneously across those subtopics and multiple data sources. The model then reasons across everything it pulled back and writes one synthesized answer with links to the web. Because the user is in a chat, they can ask follow-ups to dig deeper without starting a new search from scratch.

That fan-out step is the whole difference in behavior. A normal search — and the [AI Overview](https://roborank.io/glossary/ai-overviews/) that sits above it — is anchored to the words the user typed. AI Mode deliberately expands past them. If someone asks AI Mode to compare two options for a specific use case, it may fire separate background searches for each option, for the use case, for price, for reliability, and for alternatives, then stitch the findings together. The pages it cites are the ones that best answered each of those hidden sub-queries, not necessarily the pages that would rank for the original phrasing.

Like AI Overviews, AI Mode is [grounded](https://roborank.io/glossary/grounding/) in Google’s live search index rather than the model’s frozen training data, which is why fresh, crawlable, trustworthy pages still matter. What changes is the selection surface. Optimizing for AI Mode is less about winning one query and more about being the clearest source across a cluster of related subtopics — the core logic of [generative engine optimization](https://roborank.io/glossary/generative-engine-optimization/) and [answer engine optimization](https://roborank.io/glossary/answer-engine-optimization/).

### Example of Google AI Mode

The clearest documented example is Google’s own launch. On March 5, 2025, Google introduced AI Mode as an opt-in experiment in Search Labs, first offered to Google One AI Premium subscribers in the United States. In [the launch post](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/search/ai-mode-search/), Google described it as “a new generative AI experiment” for “questions that need further exploration, comparisons and reasoning,” running on “a custom version of Gemini 2.0.” The same post explained the mechanic directly: AI Mode “uses a query fan-out technique, issuing multiple related searches concurrently across subtopics and multiple data sources, and then brings it all together.”

Google positioned it plainly against AI Overviews. AI Overviews were already a standard, inline feature — the summary block above ordinary results. AI Mode was the opt-in, deeper experience for power users, reachable through its own tab. The two shipped as separate surfaces on the same day.

Roughly ten weeks later, at Google I/O on May 20, 2025, Google removed the opt-in wall. [The I/O update](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/search/google-search-ai-mode-update/) announced that AI Mode was rolling out to all US users with “no Labs sign-up required,” now on a custom build of Gemini 2.5. The same update introduced Deep Search inside AI Mode, which takes fan-out further — it “can issue hundreds of searches, reason across disparate pieces of information, and create an expert-level fully-cited report in just minutes.” Google also framed AI Mode as a proving ground, saying it would “graduate many features and capabilities from AI Mode right into the core Search experience” as feedback came in.

The through-line across both announcements is consistent: AI Mode is where Google tests its most aggressive AI search behavior — heavy fan-out, multi-step reasoning, sustained conversation — while AI Overviews remain the lighter, inline layer most searchers see by default.

### The thing people get wrong

The mistake I see most often is treating AI Mode and AI Overviews as the same thing measured two ways. They are two separate surfaces with different entry points, different models, and different behavior. An AI Overview is a block Google injects above the normal results for a query the user typed once; AI Mode is a place the user chooses to go, where a single question triggers dozens of background searches and the user keeps talking. A page can be cited heavily in AI Overviews and almost never surface in AI Mode, because fan-out pulls candidates for subtopics the original query never named. If your reporting collapses both into one “AI traffic” number, you cannot tell which surface is actually citing you — or which one you are losing.

### Google AI Mode vs AI Overviews

|  | Google AI Mode | AI Overviews |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Surface** | A separate tab and full chat interface the user opens | An inline summary block above the normal results list |
| **Entry** | User deliberately switches into it | Appears automatically for eligible queries |
| **Interaction** | Conversational, with follow-up questions | One-shot, tied to the single query typed |
| **Query handling** | Heavy [query fan-out](https://roborank.io/glossary/query-fan-out/) across many subtopics | Lighter retrieval anchored to the original query |
| **Launch** | Search Labs March 5, 2025; all US users May 20, 2025 | Rolled out earlier as a standard Search feature |
| **Reporting** | Track as its own [AI visibility](https://roborank.io/glossary/ai-visibility/) surface | Track separately; different pages get cited |

Both are [grounded](https://roborank.io/glossary/grounding/) in Google’s search index and both cite web pages, so the SEO fundamentals underneath them overlap. But they choose sources differently, and a page’s [citation share](https://roborank.io/glossary/citation-share/) in one tells you little about the other. Measured together, they hide each other; measured apart, each shows where you actually win — and where a [zero-click](https://roborank.io/glossary/zero-click-search/) answer is quietly satisfying the user without sending a visit.

### Frequently Asked Questions

#### What is Google AI Mode?

Google AI Mode is a conversational search experience inside Google Search, opened in its own tab, that runs a generative chat over live web results. It uses query fan-out to search many subtopics at once, returns a synthesized cited answer, and lets you ask follow-up questions.

#### Is Google AI Mode the same as AI Overviews?

No. AI Overviews are inline summaries Google shows above ordinary results for a normal search. AI Mode is a separate tab and full chat interface you deliberately open. They run on different setups and behave differently, though both cite web pages and both draw on Google’s search index.

#### When did Google launch AI Mode?

Google launched AI Mode on March 5, 2025 as an opt-in Search Labs experiment for Google One AI Premium subscribers in the US. At Google I/O on May 20, 2025 it rolled out to all US users with no sign-up required, then expanded to more countries later in 2025.

#### How does query fan-out work in AI Mode?

Query fan-out breaks your question into subtopics and issues a multitude of searches simultaneously across multiple data sources. AI Mode then reasons across those results and writes one synthesized answer, which means it can cite pages relevant to subtopics your original wording never mentioned.

### The Bottom Line

Google AI Mode is not a bigger AI Overview — it is a distinct destination where search becomes a conversation. One question fans out into many background searches, the model reasons across all of them, and the user stays to ask more. For anyone tracking AI visibility, the practical takeaway is to measure AI Mode as its own surface, because the pages it cites are chosen by subtopic fan-out, not by the single query a user typed.
